status: planned; training may start only after immutable cache manifests and split hashes are materialized
objective: Replace the latency- and memory-heavy V15.7 composite inference graph with one action-conditioned eight-frame student that preserves dual-arm texture, contact structure, temporal dynamics and official reward ranking while improving downstream strict-Track2 policy utility.

teacher.role: soft RGB/dynamics/reward-ranking teacher only; V15.7 remains frozen

student.input: five 256x256 RGB frames plus four absolute-action history steps and eight absolute future actions
student.output: eight 256x256 RGB frames in one dense forward pass
student.initialization: the frozen V15.7 v8 direct-flow component when shape-compatible; otherwise deterministic fresh initialization

training_sources.official_public_train_demonstrations: ground-truth RGB anchor; validation episodes excluded
training_sources.public_robotwin_oracle_success64: ground-truth successful contact/grasp dynamics, balanced by arm
training_sources.public_robotwin_onpolicy_training_only: ground-truth failure and recovery dynamics from non-development/non-final seeds
training_sources.local_full_budget_v157_rollout_cache: V15.7 soft targets on exact Pi0.5 policy-state coverage; no real evaluation seed or hidden official request

loss.source_entropy_purpose: favor one sharp reprojected context source per output pixel instead of averaging several slightly misaligned text glyphs
loss.static_background_mask: a pixel must remain below the motion threshold across all eight target frames; never copy context into a pixel after the gripper has moved
loss.teacher_weight_policy: decay toward zero on samples with ground truth; retain on policy-state-only samples

sampling.arm_label_source: hashed task-level window_sources.json labels; never infer arm from a short possibly-static action window
sampling.right_arm_outcome_pairing: official successful demonstrations provide the positive right-placement outcome; public Pi0.5 synthetic data provide 47 train and 7 validation right-arm failures, with zero synthetic right successes, so neither source may be used alone

promotion: Only one preregistered checkpoint passing every visual, reward, resource and policy-development gate may replace V15.7 for a formal fixed-budget run. Final128 remains untouched until then.
